title: Multi-Resident Data Association in Smart Homes via MDP Modeling and Behavior Cloning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ambient sensors offer a privacy-preserving solution for activity recognition in smart homes, yet they face a critical challenge in multi-resident environments known as Data Association, which aims to identify the resident triggering a specific anonymous sensor event. Existing approaches fundamentally fail to maintain global consistency by often yielding conflicting associations for silent residents. Additionally, these methods frequently suffer from severe trajectory fragmentation caused by the ontological mismatch of applying continuous physical motion models to discrete logical behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that reformulates data association as a sequential decision-making task within a Markov Decision Process (MDP). translated_title: 基于MDP建模与行为克隆的智能家居多居民数据关联
translated_abstract: 环境传感器为智能家居中的活动识别提供了一种隐私保护解决方案，但它们在多居民环境中面临一个关键挑战，即数据关联问题，其目标是识别触发特定匿名传感器事件的居民。现有方法从根本上无法保持全局一致性，常常为沉默的居民产生相互冲突的关联结果。此外，由于将连续物理运动模型应用于离散逻辑行为所导致的本体论不匹配，这些方法经常遭受严重的轨迹碎片化问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一个新颖的框架，将数据关联重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的序贯决策任务。我们通过行为克隆（BC）来求解所定义的MDP，通过直接从专家演示中学习，从而避免了复杂的奖励工程。我们使用两个互补的（策略实现方式，摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出将智能家居多居民数据关联问题重新建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的序贯决策任务，并通过行为克隆直接从专家演示中学习求解，有效解决了现有方法全局一致性差和轨迹碎片化严重的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates multi-resident data association in smart homes as a sequential decision-making task within a Markov Decision Process, solved via Behavior Cloning to directly learn from expert demonstrations without complex reward engineering, addressing global consistency failures and trajectory fragmentation in existing approaches.
